description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointProxy class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the HRM reporting API plugin. The class extends a base Endpoint class and primarily acts as a proxy, delegating method calls to its parent. It provides methods for obtaining request objects, request parameters, validation decorators, and setting/getting sorting and pagination parameters.

classes.name: EndpointProxy
classes.description: A proxy class for API endpoint operations within the OrangeHRM reporting plugin, delegating core functionality to its parent Endpoint class.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns a Request object by delegating to the parent Endpoint's getRequest method.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Retrieves RequestParams by delegating to the parent's getRequestParams method.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Obtains a ValidationDecorator object by calling the parent's getValidationDecorator method.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Sets sorting and pagination parameters based on provided FilterParams and optional default sort field, delegating to the parent method.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Returns rules for sorting and pagination parameters, delegated from the parent class.
